answer.explanation: Throughout the window the CrudApi function logs AccessDeniedException on dynamodb:PutItem against lambda-rca-bench-CartTable-16124ULMPVK4O, roughly 35 to 39 denials per minute at peak and 226 matched lines overall. The live inline policy app-policy on lambda-rca-bench-CrudApiRole-yMmCSPkJv9jm grants only dynamodb:GetItem and dynamodb:Query. The SAM template (IaC) intends PutItem, GetItem and Query, so the role has drifted from its intended state. The live configuration (memory, timeout, environment, concurrency) matches the template. The function's code does not need changing; the fix is to restore dynamodb:PutItem to the role. The earlier OUTPUT_BUCKET change for the Compression function (22ac2c5, reverted in d77424d) is not active in the window: its live configuration is correct and its logs show no errors.
